info.title: Example Skill — Notepad
info.description: Example skill file showing how to describe a Windows application for the computer-use agent. Replace this with a skill for your target application.

steps: Press the Windows key to open the Start Menu
Take a screenshot to confirm the window is visible

visualCues.mainArea: White text editing area filling most of the window

steps: Click inside the text editing area
Type the desired text using the type_text tool
Verify text appears in the editor
tips: Click the editing area first to ensure it has focus
For multi-line text, include newline characters in the text string

steps: If a Save As dialog appears, navigate to the desired folder
Click the 'File name' field and type the filename
x-agent-instructions.verification: Window title changes from 'Untitled' to the saved filename.

applicationOverview.name: Notepad
applicationOverview.purpose: Create and edit plain text files

windowLayout.titleBar: Top of window — shows filename and 'Notepad'
windowLayout.editingArea: Large white area filling most of the window
windowLayout.statusBar: Bottom of window — shows cursor position
